title: Rise of Buddhism
summary: Buddhism was founded in northeast India around 500 BCE by Siddhartha Gautama, whose traditional dates one scholar gives as 546–486 BCE. World History Encyclopedia describes it as a relatively minor school until the reign of Ashoka of the Mauryan Empire (268–232 BCE). A university course outline says missionaries travelled in his time to Sri Lanka and much of Southeast Asia.

uncertainty.note: Sources give different Buddha dates (546–486 or c. 563–483 BCE); start is the "ca. 500 BCE" founding date, end is the last year of Ashoka's reign (232 BCE = -231).
